The drums have shiny, iridescent blue and silver shells with chrome hardware.
Each drum has a white drumhead and is accompanied by wooden drumsticks tied with red ribbon.
A yellow sticker with the word 'Music' and CE mark is visible on one drum in the background.
The drums appear to be new and unused, still in packaging.
The watermark 'GIFTS AND GIGGLES' is overlaid on both photos.
The drums are arranged in a stack, suggesting multiple units are available or for sale.
